verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair question for an AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out or data-usage policy for code and prompts. Enterprise compliance and managed-policy features are adjacent controls, and the anti-distillation report concerns scraper data, not user opt-out.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
